content.text: : endocardial inj → focal adherence of PLT & fibrin → microorganisms circulating in blood infect platelet-fibrin nidus
mature vegetation = a collection of fibrin, PLT, WBCs, RBC debris, & dense clusters of bacteria
S. aureus MCC, viridans strep, Enterococcus
: Chlamydia psittaci, the “ellas” (Bartonella, Legionella, Brucella, Coxiella), recent abx
: ↑ ESR, mild anemia, +RF, leukocytosis w/ Lt shift
degree AV block, BBB, complete ♡ block)
: diff venipuncture sites, ± 1h b/n first & last, 3 sets ⊕>95% cases
(ex, abscess, leaflet perf, aortic pseudoaneurysm, fistula)
Empiric antibiotic therapy warranted for any pt w/ signs of
•persistent fever after 1wk suggests a septic embolic focus or inadeq coverage
•reappearance of fever after initial resolution suggests septic emboli or drug fever
